overview_description.description: Together AI provides a cloud platform for developing, training, fine-tuning, and deploying generative artificial intelligence models using open-source technologies. Its services include serverless and dedicated model inference, GPU compute infrastructure, managed storage, code sandboxes, and model customization tools that support AI application development and production workloads. The platform also offers APIs and deployment options that enable developers and organizations to build, run, and manage language, image, audio, vision, and code models without maintaining underlying infrastructure.

about_short_description.short_description: Together AI provides a cloud platform for developing, training, fine-tuning, and deploying generative AI models.

product.name: Serverless Inference
product.description: API-based access to open-source models for on-demand inference without managing infrastructure or making long-term capacity commitments.

product.name: GPU Clusters
product.description: Managed GPU clusters for training, fine-tuning, and inference workloads, scaling from instant self-serve deployments to large multi-GPU environments.

product.name: Fine-Tuning
product.description: A managed service for adapting open-source models with customer data to improve task performance, behavior, accuracy, and response quality.

product.name: Dedicated Model Inference
product.description: Dedicated infrastructure for deploying models with reserved hardware, predictable performance, and greater control over serving configuration.

product.name: Provisioned Throughput
product.description: Reserved inference capacity with token-based pricing, committed throughput, and a 99% uptime SLA for production API workloads.

product.name: Batch Inference
product.description: Asynchronous inference for large workloads, supporting processing of up to 30 billion tokens per model across serverless or private deployments.
